nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Out of a dead sleep. Barking at the window. Orange light on the ceiling.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Gil's garage is burning. Shapes in the alley with bottles. Gil's shotgun goes off once, then nothing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Someone's spray-painted the door: REQUISITIONED. The Authority came Tuesday. Gil fought. Now this.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: I'm going. Get the extinguisher. Braith, the extinguisher—

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: No. I'm the one who knows where his bedroom is. Cover me or don't.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She's already out the door. You go after her, because what else is there.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They scatter when Wraith hits the first one. Half the garage is gone. Gil is sitting in the gutter.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Smoke like a wall. Carly ahead of you, low, calling his name. She finds him. You carry him.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Carly finds Gil in the kitchen behind the garage. She drags; you lift. Out onto the cold lawn.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: My tools. Thirty-one years of tools. ...Listen here. Thank you. Don't make it weird.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Your tool roll was in my truck. Truck's fine. It's yours. You'll need it more than me.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The fire burns down by dawn. The cottonwood leaves along the street are black with soot.
